newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING - Pierce Leahy at $18,top of range.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING - Pierce Leahy at $18,top of range.

text.p: NOTE: The King of Prussia, Pa., company is a provider of managing archived records with 50 million cubic feet. It manages microfilm and video tapes but 95 percent of its revenue comes from storing paper records.
It has also filed for a high-yield offering of $100 million in senior subordinated notes due in 2007.

In early June, Moody's said the company's "high debt and lease burden may continue to strain fixed-charge coverages and the ability of the company to tap a large amount of bank debt poses acquisition risk. The planned public offering of equity will provide the company with a much needed alternative financing source for growth".
